walkthroughs.h2: Why did the Bolsheviks succeed in October?
walkthroughs.body_html: Provisional Government legitimacy was exhausted. Bolshevik majorities in soviets, peasant land seizures and worker control in factories provided base support. Lenin's letters from Finland pressured the Central Committee; on 10 October it voted 10-2 for insurrection. Trotsky used the Military Revolutionary Committee to seize bridges, telephones and the Winter Palace on 25-26 October with minimal bloodshed.

The Second Congress of Soviets ratified power on 26 October. The Decree on Peace called for immediate armistice; the Decree on Land legalised peasant seizures; the Decree on Workers' Control gave factory committees authority. Sovnarkom included Lenin (chair), Trotsky (foreign affairs) and Stalin (nationalities). The Cheka was established 20 December to combat counter-revolution.

Soviet historiography portrayed October as a popular revolution. Western liberal historians like Richard Pipes argued it was a conspiratorial coup. Revisionists such as Sheila Fitzpatrick and Alexander Rabinowitch emphasised Bolshevik responsiveness to worker and soldier demands. The dissolution of the Constituent Assembly on 6 January 1918, after Bolsheviks gained only 175 of 715 seats, has remained central to the debate.

mcqs.q: How did the Bolsheviks seize power in October 1917?
options: The October Revolution overthrew the Tsar.
The April Theses created the Soviet Union.
The October Revolution was a mass popular uprising that stormed the Winter Palace.
Trotsky's Military Revolutionary Committee coordinated a near-bloodless takeover of key buildings in Petrograd from a Provisional Government that had lost army and worker support.

mcqs.q: What happened in the Russian Revolution of 1917?
options: The Bolsheviks overthrew the Tsar in 1917.
There were two revolutions: February overthrew the Tsar and installed the Provisional Government; October saw the Bolsheviks seize power from that government.
Lenin personally led the storming of the Winter Palace.
The April Theses created the Soviet Union.

mcqs.q: What did Lenin's April Theses demand in 1917?
options: Lenin personally led the storming of the Winter Palace.
Lenin's April Theses called for an immediate alliance with the Provisional Government.
No support for the Provisional Government, all power to the Soviets, end the war, redistribute land — slogans summarised as 'Peace, Bread, Land'.
The April Theses created the Soviet Union.
